message: Hi, I'm a student with a full stack certification background. My overall academic average is 79.1% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in networks and cloud computing. I want to become a Applications Developer. My family can afford at most about USD 28400 per year. I live in Hyderabad. I'm open to going abroad.

other_constraints: Interested in networks and cloud computing

explanation:
This MTech in Computer Networks in Canada aligns perfectly with your interest in networking and cloud computing. The tuition ($23650) is within budget, your academic average (79.1%) exceeds the minimum requirement (73%), and it offers a strong post-study work visa opportunity.

This MSc Software Engineering in Canada is highly relevant as it combines networking/cloud with software development, fulfilling your goal of becoming an Applications Developer. The tuition ($10800) is very affordable and the post-study work visa (36 months) is excellent.

Another strong Canadian option, this MSc Cloud Computing program combines networking and software engineering. The tuition ($13250) is well within budget, and the long post-study work visa (36 months) provides great career security.

For a low-cost international option, this MSc Cloud Computing in Germany has minimal tuition ($1950), is relevant to your interests, and requires a CS background. This makes it an excellent choice if budget is the primary constraint.

This MSc Cloud Computing in the Netherlands offers low tuition ($11850) and directly covers networking/cloud and software engineering. It is a strong international option that respects your budget while supporting your career goal.
